Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO
items.summary:
Anthropic confirmed on Tuesday that its IPO could be one of the biggest ever, even while falling short of previous expectations. Its IPO price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share and according to the Wall Street Journal's sources, Anthropic is "aiming for its shares to start trading Thursday or Friday next week."
As Reuters notes, the Anthropic IPO was previously expected to be valued at as much as $2 trillion. As of last week, Anthropic's rival OpenAI was valued at $1.25 trillion.

Aura’s next color E Ink photo frame is smaller, cheaper, sharper, and more colorful
items.summary:
Aura just launched a smaller version of its color E Ink frame with a handful of improvements and a more affordable price. The new Aura Ink frame features a 10-inch E Ink panel that can display more colors at a higher pixel density. It's also differentiated from the original 13-inch model with a black frame and matching mat board that helps photos stand out.

items.title: Peak Design’s Roller Lite Carry-On is bigger on the inside — and cheaper, too
items.summary:
When we sampled Peak Design's Roller Pro last year, we loved almost everything about the camera gear powerhouse's first attempt at a proper suitcase. Everything, that is, except for the price. Back then, during its crowdfunded launch, the Pro could be had for as little as $425. Today, you're looking at $599.95 for the same roller bag.
Peak Design has taken that feedback to heart in creating the Roller Lite Carry-On, part of a new series of suitcases that bring many of the Pro's features and design concepts into a hard-sided clamshell design that's more traditional and, crucially, more affordable, starting with the $449.95 Lite Carry-On.

items.title: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
items.summary:
Adobe is committing itself to the notion that chatbots and AI agents could be your next design assistant, or even automate creative workflows and repetitive tasks on your behalf. Some of the tools and features announced today at Adobe's Max conference in Miami, Florida, include allowing your preferred third-party AI agents to access and change Creative Cloud projects, new capabilities for Adobe's Firefly AI Assistant, and the ability for AI agents to keep perpetually running recurring work in the background.

items.title: Amazon turned its Alexa robot into a Ring security patrol bot
items.summary:
As part of a new brand called Ring Robotics - designed to take a more proactive approach to security instead of just monitoring - a new rolling mobile security camera was announced by Amazon, called the Ring Rover Cam. It borrows a lot of the design and functionality from the Astro home robot that Amazon first debuted in 2021. The Rover Cam is targeted at businesses in need of an affordable security solution that can patrol and investigate concerns in large facilities, and it comes with a few upgrades.

items.title: Hands-on with Ring’s new AI drone camera for your home
items.summary:
Ring’s new Drone Cam is a flying indoor security camera.	

Ring is finally shipping a flying indoor drone camera. For real this time. The Ring Drone Cam will arrive on January 27th, 2027, for $249.99, Ring founder Jamie Siminoff said at a launch event in New York City this week. If it does actually ship, it will arrive almost six years after the company announced its first flying camera, the Ring Always Home Cam.
Designed to patrol inside your home when you're not there, the Drone Cam is an AI-powered drone that can react to triggers from Ring sensors, such as detecting motion, a door opening, a water leak, or an alarm sounding. When triggered, it flies along preprogrammed routes to a set location, …

Seagate’s FireCuda Forge moves your data between a hard drive and SSD for better performance
items.summary:
Seagate announced a new external storage solution, called the FireCuda Forge, that combines the speed benefits of an SSD with the affordability of a higher-capacity hard drive. The Forge is the first drive that's powered by the company's new Alkemi intelligent storage platform, which learns how your data is used and relocates the files you're currently using, or use most frequently, to the faster SSD.
The FireCuda Forge is now available through Seagate's online store with an 8TB hard drive for $699, or a 20TB hard drive for $899, that are both user-replaceable. However, the NVMe SSD is not included, and in the middle of a memory shortage, t …

Real Motors’ Project Ares is a cyberpunk fantasy made real
items.summary:
Electrification has done wonderful things for motorcycle design. By getting rid of the engine and the fuel tank that supports it, designers have the freedom to do whatever they want, and the results have been occasionally brilliant. I'm a big fan of the vaguely retrofuturistic stylings of the Maeving RM2 and the quirky minimalism of BMW's CE 02, but nothing yet has quite left me so awestruck as Project Ares.
